'''Arkinnea''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located in the [[Axion sector/Legends|Axion sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of space. The planet suffered at the hands of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] and at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was overrun with refugees. The [[Arkinnea Militia|local militia]] was very hostile to refugees, in particular to those that might affiliated with the CIS. Despite promises to said refugees to offer them land on Arkinnea to start their lives anew, the militia systematically murdered many refugees by loading them onto ships, then dumping them out hundreds of feet in the air to their deaths.

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]], [[Padawan/Legends|padawan]] [[Chase Piru]] and the rest of the [[Soaring Hawkbat Clan|younglings]] under his protection were shot down over the planet and placed in a holding center after being captured by the local militia. After meeting another survivor, Master [[Zao]], the group of Jedi discovered an [[Hidden Temple (Arkinnea)|abandoned Jedi Outpost]] and with the help of the native [[Yunu]] used it as a shelter during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="DT:FC1">[[Dark Times—Fire Carrier 1|''Dark Times—Fire Carrier'' 1]]</ref>
